hypothesis: A dominant chromatic spatial frequency is sufficiently specific to warn about screen recapture.
candidate: maximum conjugate-pair Fourier power / total chromatic power, over periods 4 through 32 pixels; require chromatic standard deviation >= 4 byte levels and concentration >= 0.35

decisions.reject_generic_warning: any benign security-texture or statement fixture crosses the frozen threshold
decisions.promotion: never from this toy study; requires rights-cleared real DEV recaptures and bona fide documents, then independent calibration

scope: Original procedural graphics, no names, portraits, personal IDs, external media, TEST, reserved identities, weights, training or threshold search. Surrogate positives are not real presentation attacks.
retention: Freeze source and protocol hashes before scoring; exclusive report creation; retain all per-fixture outcomes including counterexamples. No application acceptance rule changes.
